description: Utilities for WebSocket client connections. Enables connecting to WebSocket servers, sending and receiving messages, and handling connection events.

instructions.description: Connects to a WebSocket server at the specified URL. The connection will remain open until explicitly closed or an error occurs.
instructions.name: Connect WebSocket

parameters.description: WebSocket URL to connect to, e.g. 'ws://localhost:8080' or 'wss://example.com'
parameters.name: url

parameters.description: Function to be called when a message is received from the WebSocket server

handlerTemplate.description: Handles incoming messages from the WebSocket server. The function receives the message payload and has access to the WebSocket client resource for sending responses.
handlerTemplate.name: Handle WebSocket message

parameters.name: onMessage

parameters.description: Function to be called when the WebSocket connection is closed

handlerTemplate.description: Handles WebSocket connection close events. Called when the connection to the WebSocket server is closed, either normally or due to an error.
handlerTemplate.name: Handle WebSocket close

parameters.name: onClose

parameters.description: Function to be called when an error occurs with the WebSocket connection

handlerTemplate.description: Handles WebSocket connection errors. Called when an error occurs with the WebSocket connection. The function receives the error message and has access to the WebSocket client resource.
handlerTemplate.name: Handle WebSocket error

parameters.name: onError

parameters.description: Headers map to include in the request
parameters.name: headers

instructions.description: Handles incoming messages from the server
instructions.name: Handle WebSocket message

instructions.description: Sends a message over the WebSocket client connection. If no WebSocket client resource is available, the action will fail.
instructions.name: Send message

parameters.description: Message to send. Can be a string, object (will be serialized to JSON), or array of numbers (will be sent as binary)
parameters.name: message

instructions.description: Closes the WebSocket connection and consumes the WebSocket client resource. If no WebSocket client resource is available, the action will fail.
instructions.name: Close WebSocket
